disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was triggered by the qwen model returning 'inconclusive' due to an HTTP 400 API error when reviewing .nvchecker.toml, while the deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and returned 'safe'. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .nvchecker.toml due to an API error (HTTP 400), resulting in an overall inconclusive verdict.
learnings: The audit tool should handle partial API failures gracefully. A failure to review a low-risk metadata file like .nvchecker.toml should not force the entire package audit to 'inconclusive' if the critical packaging files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO) are successfully reviewed and deemed safe.
Implement automatic retries for transient API errors (like HTTP 400/500) before marking a file or the whole audit as inconclusive.
